players.product: power MOSFETs for AI server / data-center power supplies (8th-gen 40V/60V MV SGT MOSFETs for PSU synchronous rectification, 6th-gen 600V SJ MOSFETs), plus IGBTs and licensed SiC technology

quarterly_data.signal: Magnachip's 10-K: total revenues were $178.9 million in fiscal year 2025, an 8.9% decrease from $196.4 million in 2024, due to the phase-out of transitional Fab 3 foundry services revenue ($10.6 million in 2024) and lower Power Solutions revenue. Power Solutions net sales were $178.9 million versus $185.8 million: Power Analog Solutions $160.5 million (vs $166.8 million, gross margin 14.9% vs 18.9%) and Power IC $18.4 million (vs $19.0 million, gross margin 41.0% vs 44.4%); total gross margin 17.6% versus 19.7%.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $178.9 million in 2025 (-8.9% vs $196.4 million); Power Analog Solutions $160.5 million; Power IC $18.4 million; gross margin 17.6%

quarterly_data.signal: Magnachip's 10-K: capital expenditures for property, plant and equipment were $30.0 million in 2025, a 158.6% increase from $11.6 million in 2024; approximately $21.4 million related to investments to upgrade its fabrication facility in Gumi, Korea, which are expected to support the development of new generation products and new tools to optimize product mix and improve gross margin.
quarterly_data.figure: capex $30.0 million in 2025 (+158.6% vs $11.6 million); approximately $21.4 million for the Gumi fab upgrade

quarterly_data.signal: Magnachip's 10-K on its manufacturing model: it manufactures Power Analog Solutions products using its in-house manufacturing facility as well as an external foundry, and outsources the Power IC products that require advanced technology and 8-inch wafer capacity to an external foundry (not named) - it started outsourcing 8-inch wafers for Power IC after selling its Cheongju fab (Fab 4) in 2020; silicon wafer production at the external foundry is allocated solely by the vendor, and Power IC uses standard BCD process technologies that can be sourced from multiple foundries. For the packaging and testing it outsources, it uses subcontractors in Korea and China; onboarding a new subcontractor takes approximately three to six months plus six to twelve months for customer approval.
